Name: GameScale
Description: Fix scale on the game skeletons: global scale and non uniform scale

attrs.Help_string:
Overview:
  Makes the game skeletons follow scale: global scale at any size and non uniform scale on any ctrl.

How To Use:
  Keep this block at the very end of the build, below ConvertBody and the Mannequin block. Nothing else to set.

Fields:
- FixBodySkeleton: fixes the _Skl skeleton from ConvertBody.
- FixUnrealSkeleton: fixes the root skeleton from the Mannequin block. Turn it off in templates without that skeleton.
- FixMouthScale: MouthGames lips keep their shape when the rig scales or the head turns.
- FixPushScale: push joints keep their place and push the same amount at any size. Does nothing without push joints.

Tips:
- Each joint gets its own world scale from its _Bnd joint, with Segment Scale Compensate on, so no shear goes down the chain.
- These joints no longer have parent constraints, so bake them before deleting anything for export.
